requirements_transferred: Both products expose the same complete provider-supported LLM feature surface.
Governance constrains consequence and authority rather than silently reducing reasoning or conversation capability.
VA external factual grounding is limited to admitted official va.gov sources.
Privacy-approved user records are separately labeled and never converted into VA authority.
General web, model memory, and VA lookalike domains fail closed as Claims factual sources.
Required denied VA grounding blocks before provider-envelope creation.
Tool calls remain candidate-only until separately admitted.
Candidate responses reject unknown citations, incorrect labels, executed-tool claims, side effects, authority, publication, and custody claims.
Raw PII, documents, credentials, identity artifacts, prompts, model data, traces, and logs fail before provider input.
One real Claims request requires privacy PASS, exact provider authority, fresh TVC admission, protected Master Records bindings, and cost no greater than USD 0.10.
Ecosystem activation requires provider use, persistence, both custody chains, reconstruction, immutable VERIFIED receipt, Site activation, and downstream ingestion.
Claims custody requires a privacy-minimized execution receipt and separate operational privacy event.
Urgent safety remains fail closed until a current official source is admitted.
Private document upload and filing remain disabled until their explicit gates pass.
No unresolved task is assigned vaguely to external or manual work.
No secret value may be synthesized, copied into source, logs, receipts, or artifacts.
Deleting this chat after validation and claim release must not impair execution.
